title: 集合郵便受け（12戸）
description: 集合住宅のエントランスに並ぶ、3列×4段・12戸分の壁付け郵便受けです。灰色の本体と天板、銀色の扉、投函口とフラップ、無地の名札窓、ダイヤル錠を造形しています。原点は底面中央で、壁取付けの高さ・ビスは含みません。名札・部屋番号などの文字、郵便物、扉の開閉動作はありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.040 × 0.686 × 0.362 m、9,912三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A 3×4, twelve-unit wall mailbox bank for apartment entrances. It models the grey carcass and top cap, satin silver doors, insertion slots with flaps, blank name-card windows and dial locks. The origin is at the bottom center; wall mounting height and screws are not included. No names, unit numbers or other lettering, mail, or door motion is provided. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.040 × 0.686 × 0.362 m; 9,912 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or mounting pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Claude
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
